history_short: Kristian Thalai Pawl chu Sihphir Presbyterian Kohhran thalai te tan a awm a, kohhran thalai zawng zawng an tel thei a nih. Thalai te Pathian biak dan hmasawn dan leh nungchang tha zir dan an buatsaih a nih.
history_full:
KTP chu thalai te tan a awm a, Fellowship hmang hian thalai te Bible zir dan, inkhawm dan leh kohhran tan thawhlawm dan an zir a nih.

KTP Inleng chu weekly-in a chhuak a, kohhran thalai leh member te tan bulletin a ni a, KTP inkhawm program leh thupui te an tarlan a nih.

Thalai te nungchang tha nei thei nan leh Pathian tan thawhlawm dan zir nan, fellowship hi a pawimawh hle a nih.
